changes.description: Restructured the Current month header with page controls above a full-width summary grid that adapts to phones, tablets, desktops, long labels, and large amounts
Kept expenses linked to their category when it is renamed and added inline feedback for duplicate category names
Cleared Todo tag filters and item selections when switching, creating, or deleting lists so tasks are not unexpectedly hidden
Normalized email addresses during initial setup, user creation, and login to handle surrounding spaces and mixed-case addresses consistently
Handled Google sign-in connection failures with a return to login and a clear retry message instead of a server error
Made Member and Child role controls set the selected role consistently, including repeated clicks, while preserving master-user protections
Corrected weekly and monthly chore template scheduling, validated recurrence days, and reset template state when changing schedules or reopening the editor
Validated chore proof images before generating previews, displayed upload errors, and aligned file selection and help text with the supported PNG, JPG, and WebP formats and 5 MB limit
Added missing Kids form validation feedback and cleared stale validation errors when reopening Kids and user creation dialogs
Made chore Templates available on mobile, improved template modal scrolling, and added keyboard-accessible assignee buttons with selection states
Prevented long shopping and Todo list names, user names, and child names from overflowing selectors, cards, and template controls
Restored shared accessibility scripts, skip navigation, and the favicon on directly loaded Kids and Admin pages
Limited Admin navigation to administrators and refreshed module navigation immediately after module settings change
Corrected removal of allowed email addresses containing apostrophes and improved authentication settings help, validation feedback, and section navigation
Updated the settings version display to use application history and expanded Swedish translations for category validation, authentication guidance, and upload limits
Reused loaded child records when displaying chore template assignments to avoid repeated user lookups
Added regression coverage and documented the application audit across authentication, permissions, list filtering, categories, chore templates, uploads, accessibility, and responsive layouts
Added a redesigned Household Productivity dashboard that combines Todo and Kids chore completions across eight readable weekly trends
Added actionable productivity metrics for this week, week-over-week change, open workload, and the 30-day task completion rate
Reorganized Shopping and Todo inline editing on mobile into clear primary and secondary rows with touch-friendly controls and accessible field labels
Redesigned Economy income, monthly savings, category, and expense editors as structured mobile cards while preserving the desktop table layouts
Redesigned Savings goal editing on mobile with grouped primary and financial fields, clearer actions, and improved narrow-screen spacing
Corrected Shopping and Todo completion controls so their visible checkboxes remain perfectly circular on desktop and mobile
Completed an application-wide responsive layout pass covering narrow phones through large desktops, including Kids, History, Audit Log, and Admin screens

Expanded keyboard and screen-reader accessibility with a skip link, visible focus states, semantic dialogs, focus trapping and restoration, Escape handling, switch semantics, and descriptive control labels
Standardized touch targets, disabled states, modal behavior, reduced-motion support, and mobile form sizing throughout the application
Updated initial setup with explicit labels, identifiers, autocomplete hints, and more appropriate input types
Converted Audit Log rows into complete mobile cards and corrected fixed-width History, Kids, Savings, and Admin layouts that could overflow on small screens
Prevented duplicate blank Economy categories by assigning unique default names when several categories are created
Expanded English and Swedish localization for the new productivity, editor, accessibility, and category interface text
Expanded feature and responsive regression coverage for dashboard metrics, Economy categories, interactive editing, accessibility, and horizontal overflow across the application
Added a One-time expense option that keeps charges in Monthly History snapshots and automatically removes them from the live expenses list after the monthly capture runs
Expanded the Economy expenses editor with a bottom add-row action and clearer option badges for split, delayed, and one-time fees
Reworked mobile navigation into a fixed bottom tab bar with sheet-based sub-navigation for modules like Economy and a dedicated More tray for account and admin actions
Reduced mobile navigation friction by replacing the previous hamburger flow with faster thumb-reachable access patterns
Refined Savings management with dedicated View/Edit modes and responsive mobile optimization
Optimized application structure by removing redundant 'lightningbolt' components and empty directories
Standardized dashboard summary cards and resolved layout overlaps on mobile devices
Premium Mobile Modal UX with centered layouts and edge-to-edge headers
Viewport-pinned FAB (Floating Action Button) for Todo and Shopping list management
Smart Auto-Scroll and Instant-Focus logic for high-speed item entry
Dedicated Grocery Sorting system based on Swedish store aisle heuristics
Teleported success notifications to ensure visibility across all scroll depths
Full Application-wide localization (English & Swedish) across all core modules
Complete Swedish translation sweep for Shopping, Todo, and Kids systems
Resolved all hardcoded English strings in UI and confirm dialogs
Capitalized Swedish month names in History and Dashboard views
Expanded sv.json with missing keys identified during thorough UI audit
Admin Impersonation system with quick-revert sidebar banner
Stabilized Kids module by consolidating Alpine.js teleported modals
Optimized Economy summary grid to prevent horizontal stacking issues
New 'header-stats' utility for compact, responsive page summaries
Added overflow scroll support to all modals to prevent height issues on smaller screens
Refined Home Dashboard with responsive mobile layouts and fluid spacing
Consolidated database migrations into clean 'create' files for better maintainability
Added dynamic environment-aware snapshot scheduling for Docker deployments
Moved application history to static JSON for persistent release notes without database dependencies
Integrated Economy Module with Income and Savings tracking
Improved Todo List with due date categories and status filtering
Added Administrative UI for module activation and system settings
Initial Release of Homeplanner core system
Support for Google Authentication and Multi-user households
Basic Shopping List and Todo management modules
